summary: GFL Environmental Inc. furnished a routine Form 6-K on September 24, 2026 containing a press release that merely sets the date for its third-quarter 2026 earnings release and investor conference call. The results are scheduled for Wednesday, October 28, 2026, after market close, with the call on Thursday, October 29, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. ET; dial-in and webcast details were provided. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed. This is an ordinary scheduling announcement, not a special situation; watch for quarterly results and any guidance updates.
